title: The first time the cap bites

steps.label:
Under the cap. No episode yet,
none needed.

Cap crossed with no episode.
The reply is sent first, no wait.

The episode half of the extractor
runs in the background. One Haiku call.

The next turn picks the episode up
and prepends it.

example: Turn 21 answers at once; the Haiku call runs after.
Turn 22 finds the episode and prepends it.
Not taken: write it first and make the athlete wait.
